children: Short-term holders are selling at a loss, but there is no sign of large-scale capitulation. According to Odaily, CryptoQuant analyst Axel Adler Jr. said the short-term holder realized profit-to-loss ratio (STH-SOPR) fell to 0.993, indicating loss-making sales. The indicator has fallen lower during previous periods of market stress.

title: Analyst: Short-Term Holders Sell at a Loss, but No Mass Capitulation Seen
